First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}2xy-2x-{y}^{2}+8\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{[x{y}^{2}-2xy-\frac{{y}^{3}}{3}+8y]}_{y=0}^{y=1}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(x-2x-\frac{1}{3}+8)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(\frac{23}{3}-x)\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}(\frac{23}{3}-x)\,\text{d}x & ={[\frac{23x}{3}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}]}_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{23}{3}-\frac{1}{2} \\  & =\frac{43}{6}\end{aligned}
$$
